name: Teemo GDB Integration
description: Export Binary Ninja HLIL analysis as DWARF debug information for GDB
longdescription: Teemo exports typed analysis, generated pseudocode line mappings, lexical scopes, and proven variable locations through a versioned JSON IR into a relocatable ELF DWARF object.

installinstructions.Linux: Copy this directory to ~/.binaryninja/plugins/teemo and build the Rust emitter with make -C dwarf emitter-release.

author: pwnc contributors
